DApp360 Workforce is on the mission to increase the number of decentralize application developers. We set about doing this through: Training- We provide funding and training to qualified software engineers, developers and others who aspire to become decentralize application developers. Recruiting- For employers we provide talent matching that includes Aptitude testing, and various other screenings. Job board- We provide a Job board which focuses only on Tech jobs with in the blockchain ecosystem.
